packageRules.description: Restricted registry lacks newer versions; remove once available

Pinned to the version pi ships. Pi's extension loader aliases typebox to its own bundled copy, so our declaration only types what pi executes and must match it. It moves when pi moves, not on Renovate's schedule; the typebox pin test reports when that happens.

@types/node describes the runtime, so it tracks the Node these packages run on rather than the newest DefinitelyTyped release. Types from a later major describe APIs that are not there and hide ones that were removed, and tsc believes them either way. Raise the ceiling when the toolchain in mise.toml moves.
